name: obsidian-open-with-external-editor
description: Right-click any file or folder in Obsidian to open it in a configurable external editor (VSCode, etc.), jumping to the current cursor position when the file is already open.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css versions.json ../test-vault/.obsidian/plugins/open-with-external-editor/
